SELECT pm.product_id AS productId, pp.code, pp.title, pm.platform_type AS platformType FROM product_media pm JOIN platform_product pp ON pp.id = pm.product_id WHERE pm.platform_type = #{platformType} AND pm.file_type=1 AND pm.img_pos IN (1,2,3,4,5)
AND (pp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pp.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND pm.id IN ( SELECT id FROM product_media WHERE product_id = pm.product_id AND file_type=1 AND img_pos IN (1,2,3,4,5) AND visual_score >= #{scoreMin} AND visual_score <= #{scoreMax} )
GROUP BY pm.product_id, pp.code, pp.title, pm.platform_type ORDER BY MAX(pm.visual_score) DESC

SELECT id, source_product_code AS code, source_product_name AS title, head_img_url AS fileUrl, visual_score AS visualScore, platform_type AS platformType FROM source_product WHERE is_deleted=0 AND head_img_url IS NOT NULL
AND (source_product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR source_product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND visual_score >= #{scoreMin} AND visual_score <= #{scoreMax} ORDER BY visual_score DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.visual_score IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unscored, ROUND(AVG(pm.visual_score), 1) AS avgScore, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.visual_score = 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countS, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.visual_score >= 95 AND pm.visual_score < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countAPlus, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.visual_score >= 90 AND pm.visual_score < 95 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countA, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.visual_score >= 80 AND pm.visual_score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countB, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.visual_score >= 70 AND pm.visual_score < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countC, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.visual_score >= 60 AND pm.visual_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countD, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.visual_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countDMinus FROM product_media pm JOIN (SELECT product_id, MIN(id) AS mid FROM product_media WHERE file_type=1 GROUP BY product_id) t ON pm.id = t.mid WHERE pm.platform_type = #{platformType}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN visual_score IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unscored, ROUND(AVG(visual_score), 1) AS avgScore, SUM(CASE WHEN visual_score = 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countS, SUM(CASE WHEN visual_score >= 95 AND visual_score < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countAPlus, SUM(CASE WHEN visual_score >= 90 AND visual_score < 95 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countA, SUM(CASE WHEN visual_score >= 80 AND visual_score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countB, SUM(CASE WHEN visual_score >= 70 AND visual_score < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countC, SUM(CASE WHEN visual_score >= 60 AND visual_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countD, SUM(CASE WHEN visual_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countDMinus FROM source_product WHERE is_deleted=0 AND head_img_url IS NOT NULL

SELECT variant_set AS variantSet, img_pos AS imgPos, rule_name AS ruleName, file_url AS fileUrl, visual_score AS visualScore FROM product_media_variant WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND platform_type = #{platformType} ORDER BY variant_set, img_pos, rule_name
